description: A user needs to plan a weekly grocery shop for a family of 4, focusing on healthy ingredients and staying under a fictional budget ($150).

fact_sheet.fact: The primary grocery shopper for the family is Jenna Miller, age 33.
The Miller family consists of 4 members: Jenna, her husband Mark, and two children, Leo (age 8) and Mia (age 5).
The strict weekly grocery budget for the Miller family is $150.00.
Jenna Miller performs the main weekly grocery shopping trip every Saturday between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM.
Jenna uses the mobile app 'ListifyPro' to manage her grocery lists; her username is 'jmiller89'.
The primary grocery store is 'FreshFare Market', located at 452 Orchard Drive, Meadowbrook.
For bulk items like oats and rice, Jenna shops once a month at 'BulkBuy Warehouse' on 910 Commerce Way.
Jenna Miller's 'FreshFare Rewards' loyalty card number is 987-654-3210, which provides a 5% discount on produce.
The son, Leo Miller, has a diagnosed mild allergy to peanuts.
A key nutritional goal for the week is to ensure each family member consumes at least 4 servings of vegetables per day.
This week's meal plan includes 'Baked Salmon with Roasted Asparagus' for Wednesday's dinner.
Monday's planned dinner is 'Lentil Soup' to start the week with a plant-based meal.
The shopping list for this week includes 2 lbs of organic, free-range chicken breast from FreshFare Market.
FreshFare Market currently has a sale on organic Gala apples for $1.29 per pound; the list requires 4 lbs.
Due to Leo's allergy, the shopping list specifies 'SunBloom' brand sunflower seed butter instead of peanut butter.
Mia's favorite healthy snack is 'Stonyfield Farms' brand organic strawberry yogurt tubes.
Jenna allocates $95.00 of the budget for FreshFare Market and reserves $55.00 for the monthly BulkBuy Warehouse trip.
Jenna meal preps lunches for herself and Mark every Sunday afternoon, typically making a large batch of quinoa salad.
A 32oz container of 'Fage' brand 2% Greek yogurt is on the list, priced at $5.29.
The list includes one half-gallon of 'AlmondBreeze' unsweetened vanilla almond milk for smoothies and cereal.
The family aims to limit added sugar intake to less than 25 grams per person per day.
Jenna receives the weekly digital flyer from FreshFare Market via email at jenna.m.89@email.com every Tuesday.
The children's school lunch plan for Tuesday is whole wheat pasta with turkey meatballs and a side of steamed broccoli.
One bunch of organic kale is on the list, costing $2.99 at FreshFare Market.
Mark prefers 'Dave's Killer Bread' 21 Whole Grains and Seeds variety for his sandwiches.
A quick mid-week trip for milk or fresh fruit is sometimes made on Wednesdays after 5:00 PM.
